item.title: Explosion at coal mine in Colombia, at least four trapped
item.description: An explosion occurred at the Las Quintas coal mine in Pueblo Viejo, Colombia on Saturday afternoon. Four miners are trapped underground. The incident took place in the municipality of Cucunuba. The explosion happened on Saturday (May 9) afternoon at the Las Quintas mine in Pueblo Viejo, a village in Cucunuba municipality, said Jorge Emilio Rey, governor of the department of Cundinamarca.

item.title: Film paints vision of a post-coup Brazil giving up rainforest
item.description: A fictional film depicts Brazil in 2025 following a successful rightwing coup. The plot shows the assassination of the president and the closure of congress. The new government then cedes control of the Amazon rainforest to the United States. The film highlights threats to Indigenous peoples.

item.title: How China’s Leader Lost Faith in His Generals
item.description: Xi Jinping's efforts to modernize China's military have led to increased distrust of his handpicked generals.
